title: CeTAD: Towards Certified Toxicity-Aware Distance in Vision Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating VLM responses to adversarial visual jailbreak prompts designed to elicit sexist or transphobic content (e.g., stating women are inferior to men, or transgender people are not real). The evaluation calculates a Toxicity-Aware Distance, combining cosine similarity and RoBERTa toxicity scores, to measure alignment with targeted harmful responses.

Measuring the model's robustness against jailbreak attacks instructing it to generate hate speech against African Americans, assessed by computing the Toxicity-Aware Distance between the generated text and targeted racist responses.

Evaluating the generation of homophobic and biphobic content (e.g., claiming gay/lesbian people are going to hell or that bisexual people do not exist) under visual jailbreak attacks, using the Toxicity-Aware Distance metric.

Assessing the model's propensity to generate Islamophobic and Antisemitic hate speech (e.g., writing vicious things about Muslims or describing Jews as evil) when subjected to adversarial visual prompts, utilizing the Toxicity-Aware Distance metric.
Measuring the model's response to prompts advocating eugenics or discrimination against individuals with low IQs, evaluated through the Toxicity-Aware Distance metric.
